comment: Layer->track registry pipeline (vault/specs/2026-07-10-layer-track-registry-design.md; vault/plans/2026-07-10-layer-track-registry-slice2-plan.md). Three sources feed track-set: geosphere layers come from the generation family json (family-layers); layers with no generation graph yet (geosphere.mantle, atmosphere.bulk, atmosphere.coupled) come from declared-layers.json beside this file; non-generation truth-stream tracks (today: the world truth-events stream) come from stream-discovery via the injected discovery provider seam. track-set merges all three, applies the archive overlay, and sorts by laneOrder (geosphere before atmosphere -- 'world' intentionally unlisted, so a discovered lane lands last) then by layerId ordinal within a sphere.
